affiliate_conversions_amount_check.name: affiliate_conversions_amount_check
affiliate_conversions_amount_check.value: ("affiliate_conversions"."amount" is null or "affiliate_conversions"."amount" >= 0) and ("affiliate_conversions"."commission_amount" is null or "affiliate_conversions"."commission_amount" >= 0)

analytics_events_country_code_check.name: analytics_events_country_code_check
analytics_events_country_code_check.value: "analytics_events"."country_code" is null or ("analytics_events"."country_code" = upper("analytics_events"."country_code") and length("analytics_events"."country_code") = 2)

offer_prices_numeric_check.name: offer_prices_numeric_check
offer_prices_numeric_check.value:
("offer_prices"."original_amount" is null or "offer_prices"."original_amount" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."advertised_monthly" is null or "offer_prices"."advertised_monthly" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."effective_monthly" is null or "offer_prices"."effective_monthly" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."cash_due_today" is null or "offer_prices"."cash_due_today" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."renewal_monthly" is null or "offer_prices"."renewal_monthly" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."hourly_amount" is null or "offer_prices"."hourly_amount" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."yearly_amount" is null or "offer_prices"."yearly_amount" >= 0)
        and ("offer_prices"."term_months" is null or "offer_prices"."term_months" > 0)

offers_numeric_check.name: offers_numeric_check
offers_numeric_check.value:
("offers"."vcpus" is null or "offers"."vcpus" >= 0)
        and ("offers"."ram_gb" is null or "offers"."ram_gb" >= 0)
        and ("offers"."disk_gb" is null or "offers"."disk_gb" >= 0)
        and ("offers"."bandwidth_tb" is null or "offers"."bandwidth_tb" >= 0)

provider_affiliate_programs_positive_che.name: provider_affiliate_programs_positive_check
provider_affiliate_programs_positive_che.value:
("provider_affiliate_programs"."difficulty_rank" is null or "provider_affiliate_programs"."difficulty_rank" > 0)
        and ("provider_affiliate_programs"."cookie_days" is null or "provider_affiliate_programs"."cookie_days" >= 0)
